note: Corrections from a July 2026 data audit (statuses verified against ESPN / Hoops Rumors / SalarySwish / Spotrac). waivedFreeAgents: players a team waived who are unsigned UFAs — surfaced as signable, with no Bird rights and no team cap hold. suppressDeadCap: dead-money charges that are wrong and should not sit on a team's books. resolvedOfferSheets: RFA offer sheets treated as resolved so the player leaves his old team's hold.

waivedFreeAgents.name: DeMar DeRozan
waivedFreeAgents.note: Waived by Sacramento Jul 6 2026; unsigned UFA. SAC keeps his $10M dead-money guarantee.

resolvedOfferSheetsNote: Jul 7 2026, 11:50 PM ET (Slater/ESPN, Shams, Fischer): Golden State declined to match Memphis' 3yr/$30M offer sheet (Y1 $9M guaranteed + $1.35M unlikely incentives), so Post joins the Grizzlies. No longer a pending GSW hold.
pendingSigningsNote: Larry Nance Jr. was held pending Jul 8 - Aug 17 2026: he agreed to a 1yr veteran minimum with IND ($3.88M salary, ~$2.45M cap charge), but on our reconciled sheet that charge sat ~$0.85M OVER Indiana's Oubre NT-MLE first-apron hard cap, and reporting had not resolved his guarantee structure. Released Aug 17: the feed carries the executing row (Jul 9, "Signed a 1 year $3.88 million contract", past tense with terms), and Indiana's sheet has since fallen to $203.981M — $5.034M under the $209.015M hard cap, so the deemed 2-YOS charge of $2,449,421 now fits with $2.585M to spare. The reason for the hold expired; the hold should not outlive it.
